title: Small Rocky Island St John Waters
description: this tiny rock and scrub island barely qualifies as land, just enough green to hold on against the waves breaking around it. #USVI waters are full of these forgotten formations, too small to name on most maps but impossible to ignore once you're passing by. i think the smallest islands are often the most interesting ones.
alt_text: Small rocky uninhabited island with sparse vegetation surrounded by blue water near St John

title: Hillside Villas Above Rocky Coast
description: white villas with red tile roofs climbed a rocky, cactus covered hillside above water so teal it looked lit from within. #USVI hillside real estate does not do subtle, and honestly the drama of that landscape earns it. every time I see a cliffside villa like this I start mentally redecorating a life I don't have.
alt_text: White villas with red roofs on a rocky cactus covered hillside above teal water in the US Virgin Islands

title: Beach Resort Palm Trees From Water
description: from the water, the beach resort unfolded in layers, sand and umbrellas giving way to palms and then green hills rising behind everything. #USVI beachfront resorts know exactly how to use their backdrop, and this one earns every bit of the view.
alt_text: Beach resort with palm trees, umbrellas, and hillside homes viewed from the water in the US Virgin Islands

title: Resort Beach Buoy Line Wide View
description: the swim line stretched almost the whole width of the bay, tiny white buoys marking the boundary between resort and open water. #USVI beach resorts balance safety and access in a way that somehow doesn't feel restrictive, just quietly organized against a backdrop of palm trees and hillside homes.
alt_text: Line of white buoys marking a swim boundary in front of a beach resort with palm trees and hillside homes

title: Beachfront Resort Hillside Panorama
description: the widest view yet, resort buildings tucked beneath a hill covered in houses that seemed to multiply the higher up you looked. #StThomas hillside development has this layered quality, resort at the water's edge, private homes climbing steadily toward the sky. i think this might be my favorite kind of #USVI panorama.
alt_text: Wide panoramic view of a beachfront resort below a hillside covered in homes in St Thomas

title: Resort Beach Watercraft Rentals
description: jet skis and kayaks lined up along the sand, a small boat anchored just offshore, the whole scene set against a two story resort building shaded by palms. #USVI beach resorts make water toys this accessible, and there's something satisfying about seeing all the gear ready and waiting for someone's next adventure.
alt_text: Jet skis, kayaks, and a small boat lined up on a beach in front of a resort building in the US Virgin Islands

title: Anchored Boats Hillside Homes Wide Bay
description: boats scattered across a wide bay, red tile roofs and hillside homes rising behind a rocky shoreline. #USVI anchorages like this one show off the range of island living, working boats and pleasure boats sharing the same quiet water without any fuss.
alt_text: Multiple boats anchored in a wide bay with red roofed hillside homes in the background in the US Virgin Islands

title: Seagull Perched on Teal Ferry Sign
description: this seagull claimed the top of a teal arch like it owned the whole dock, the Captain's Lady III floating patiently below, waiting for its next load of passengers. #USVI wildlife doesn't care much about anyone's schedule, and honestly I respect the confidence.
alt_text: Seagull perched on a teal metal arch above the Captain's Lady III ferry boat at a St John dock

title: Blurred Hillside Villas Waterfront View
description: soft focus caught this hillside villa mid moment, palm trees swaying, a boat idling just offshore. even a little blurry, #USVI waterfront architecture holds its own, modern lines against all that green. sometimes the imperfect photos end up being my favorites.
alt_text: Soft focus view of a modern white waterfront villa with palm trees and a boat on the water in the US Virgin Islands

title: CAT 5 Dive Boat Anchored Bay
description: the CAT 5 sat anchored between sailboats, its name painted bold across a hull built for exactly the kind of work these waters call for. #USVI dive and snorkel boats like this one carry a specific kind of promise, reef and wreck and whatever's waiting just under the surface. i always wonder what that particular boat has seen.
alt_text: White CAT 5 dive boat anchored among sailboats in a bay with hillside homes in the US Virgin Islands
